name: EPIC 220297533
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.3 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220297533 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.279378 (16th-84th percentiles 10.011324-10.528813), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,334 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.98 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,791 K at its surface.
